step_by_step_reasoning: The diagram illustrates Axileon's hybrid CI/CD pipeline. Developers commit code to an on-premise GitLab instance, which triggers builds either locally in an on-premises server farm or via Jenkins. For additional scale, CI/CD plugins initiate calls over a Site-to-Site VPN connection to Amazon EC2 APIs within an Amazon VPC, provisioning EC2 Spot Instances to execute test workloads.
